messages:
Ivy Park: quick heads-up from usability lab — table action column is super cramped at compact density. users keep hitting the kebab instead of the primary action.
Samir Bose: saw same. 13" laptops + touchpads cause mis-taps. proposal: promote primary action to visible label when there's room, otherwise make the kebab secondary and increase icon hit target.
Elena Ruiz: agree. also a tokens question — table-cell-padding-compact currently 4px. bumping to 8px for action cells would help, but that affects row height. could we use internal padding token only on action cells?
Will Chen: dev note: bumping row height affects virtualized list math. cheaper approach is wrapper element that provides extra hit area via a negative margin box so layout doesn't reflow. but must ensure it doesn't overlap adjacent interactive zones.
a11y-bot: a11y check: "Interactive elements must be >= 44x44 CSS pixels. Icon-only buttons require aria-labels and visible focus indicators."
Ivy Park: microcopy: what should the primary say? testers preferred an explicit verb+object (e.g., 'Run job' vs 'Run'). we'll add guidance to the component docs: prefer 'Verb + object' when space permits.
Samir Bose: responsive behavior idea: if container width < 420px, convert actions to a stacked layout where primary becomes a full-width button above the row details and others go into kebab. avoids tiny tap targets and keeps actions discoverable.
Elena Ruiz: good. I'll mock three states: compact-row with wrapper hit targets, compact-row with increased internal padding, and stacked-actions for narrow widths. Posting frames in #design in ~1hr.
Will Chen: implementation checklist: 1) add wrapper class to action cell with pointer-events area, 2) ensure pseudo-element doesn't steal pointer events (use pointer-events: none on it), 3) keep focus outline on real button, 4) add feature flag for virt-table to recalc heights if tokens change.
Ivy Park: a11y nit: don't rely on tooltips for discoverability. tooltips are fine for desktop but must have aria-labels for SRs and visible labels for touch. Also add aria-live announcements for actions that trigger modals or remote ops (e.g., 'Job started').
a11y-bot: follow-up: "If using an inline confirmation chip, update an aria-live region inside the table row to announce success. Do not shift focus when announcing."
Samir Bose: on copy/confirm pattern — prefer inline chip ('Copied', 'Saved') that appears next to control for 1.5s. global toast is okay as fallback when row is off-screen.
Elena Ruiz: also proposing a spacing token map update: table-action-gap-compact: 8px, table-row-height-compact: 40px (opt-in). I'll submit token proposal doc with before/after screenshots.
Will Chen: I'll prototype wrapper hit target and stacked layout in a branch, include keyboard tests. will ping infra about feature flag for virtualization recalcs.
Ivy Park: thanks team — tagging @Elena for mocks and @Will for the PR. leaving this thread open until mocks + PR linked. :thumbsup:
Samir Bose: quick add — document example aria-label patterns in the component docs (e.g., aria-label="Run job {rowName}"). small detail but prevents generic labels like 'Run' which are ambiguous in lists.
Ivy Park: perfect. will include that in the docs update.
